paragraphs: The challenge of predicting short‑term credit risk for subscription products mirrors my recent work building predictive pipelines for financial services. I designed scikit‑learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deploying them as FastAPI services in Docker to deliver real‑time risk scores. I contributed to a production‑ready model that scales with user volume and meets regulatory compliance. I proposed and prototyped an MCP‑based agentic tool in Python, using FastMCP, Ollama gpt‑oss:20b, PostgreSQL and GitHub Actions CI, for a Madrid‑based product start‑up client, and presented it in a live stakeholder demo.
